```{r}
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
# Import libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

# Read in data 
bloom <- read_csv(here::here("data", "bloom_clean.csv"))
```


## Data exploration

### Step 1: Collect statistics for use in header

#### Total species count 
How many unique species were observed over the full time period?
```{r}
# Count unique scientific names
totalspecies <- bloom %>% 
  summarise(unique_count = n_distinct(scientific_name))
```
-> 474 total species.

#### Total observations
How many plants were listed total over the full time period?
```{r}
# Number of rows where scientific name is not NA
nrow(bloom %>% filter(!is.na(scientific_name)))
```

```{r}
# Most observed plants each month (2011-2026)
top_by_month <- bloom %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name)) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  count(month, scientific_name) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Unique observations
unique <- bloom %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  count(scientific_name) %>%
  filter(n == 1) %>%
  left_join(bloom %>% mutate(year = year(date)), by = "scientific_name") %>%
  select(scientific_name, year, n)
```

```{r}
# Top 10 most commonly noted plants over full data
top10 <- bloom %>%
  filter(!is.na(scientific_name)) %>%
  count(scientific_name) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```


```{r}

top4 <- top10 %>% slice_max(n, n = 4, with_ties = FALSE)

grid_data <- bloom %>%
  filter(scientific_name %in% top4$scientific_name) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date), month = month(date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  count(scientific_name, year, month) %>%
  complete(scientific_name, year, month, fill = list(n = 0))

p <- ggplot(grid_data, aes(x = month, y = factor(year), fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "darkgreen") +
  facet_wrap(~scientific_name) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Year", fill = "Count")

ggplotly(p)
```


```{r}
bloom_shift <- bloom %>%
  filter(scientific_name %in% top4$scientific_name) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  filter(!year %in% c(2011, 2026)) %>%
  mutate(day_of_year = yday(date)) %>%
  group_by(scientific_name, year) %>%
  summarise(first_seen = min(day_of_year), last_seen = max(day_of_year), .groups = "drop")

p <- ggplot(bloom_shift, aes(x = year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = first_seen, linetype = "First observed")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = last_seen, linetype = "Last observed")) +
  facet_wrap(~scientific_name) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Day of year", linetype = "")

ggplotly(p)
```
